title: 第017章 雕龙第018章 龙钥
lines: 模拟第11年。
六月。
炎炎夏日中，来自岷江中游的大帮‘巨鲸帮’入主江淮，一手掌控出海码头，一手压服本地各方豪强。
一场动乱随之平息，各方势力似当什么都没发生过。
但这一世的陈孤舟却知道了一个消息，传袭三百年的钱姓宗族，被巨鲸帮自上而下清洗了。
没错，正是金刀帮主钱三金的宗族。
此为杀鸡儆猴！
这件事在江淮并没有掀起风浪，包括谢天宇的死。
如今大苍朝正值动乱。
官府对地方的控制力已经烂了。
模拟第12年。
陈孤舟修习《蜃蛇辟毒功》小成，修为更进一步，内气充盈八十条经脉，仿若滚滚河流。
并且多了一些辟毒能力。
他没有修行兵法【百毒刃】，一是根骨不适合，二是无法与雕龙鬼刀相融。
但百毒刃附带的一套凶险狠厉的刀法，却让他受益匪浅。
对江湖争斗、生死搏杀，有了一个清晰的认知。
“感觉现在的我，也是挺全面了，就差一些实战经验。”
模拟第13年。
陈孤舟二十九岁，再度感觉修行变慢。
蜃蛇辟毒功发挥了一些作用，却未曾助他第二次觉醒武道根骨。
不是不能。
而是他折损的七十年寿命。
随着年龄越大，他表面没有明显变化，体内气血却隐有枯竭之势。
“估计还能再活八年十年，这一世潜力已尽。”
陈孤舟做出判断。
他现在身体还处于巅峰，一旦走到人生最后几年，必定迅速衰弱。
除非。
能突破先天！
“既然如此……”
陈孤舟决定尽快获得龙头之位，而后倾尽雕龙一脉资源，全力一搏。
模拟第15年。
这一年发生了许多事。
先是周荣光的发妻柳菲，因丈夫失意之后的冷落，红杏出墙。
丑闻曝光。
周荣光颜面扫地，再没脸见人。
众人对此的态度竟是——庆幸，庆幸当初陈孤舟没选柳菲。
content_en:
Simulation Year 11.
June.
In the hot summer, a large group of "giant whale gangs" from the middle reaches of the Minjiang River took control of the Jianghuai River, controlling the seaports with one hand and subduing local powerful parties with the other.
The turmoil subsided, and all parties acted as if nothing had happened.
But in this life, Chen Guzhou learned the news that the Qian clan, which had been passed down for three hundred years, had been purged from top to bottom by the Giant Whale Gang.
Yes, it was the clan of Qian Sanjin, the leader of the Golden Knife Gang.
This is to scare the monkeys!
This incident did not cause any disturbance in Jianghuai, including Xie Tianyu's death.
Now the Great Cang Dynasty is in turmoil.
The government's control over local areas has deteriorated.
Simulation Year 12.
Chen Guzhou completed the practice of "Mirage Snake Poison Dispelling Technique", and his cultivation progressed further. The inner Qi filled eighty meridians, like a rolling river.
And it has some more poison-repelling abilities.
He has not practiced the art of war [Hundred Poison Blades]. Firstly, his bones are not suitable, and secondly, he cannot blend with the Dragon-Carved Ghost Sword.
However, he benefited a lot from the set of dangerous and fierce sword skills that came with the Hundred Poison Blades.
He has a clear understanding of rivers and lakes battles and life-and-death battles.
"I feel like I am quite comprehensive now, I just lack some practical experience."
Simulation Year 13.
Chen Guzhou was twenty-nine years old and once again felt that his spiritual practice was slowing down.
Mirage's poison-preventing skill played some role, but it did not help him awaken his martial arts roots for the second time.
It’s not that you can’t.
But the seventy years of his lost life.
As he gets older, there is no obvious change in his appearance, but the energy and blood in his body are gradually drying up.
"I estimate that I can live another eight or ten years, but my potential in this life has been exhausted."
Chen Guzhou made a judgment.
His body is still at its peak now, but once he reaches the last few years of his life, he will surely decline rapidly.
unless.
Can break through the innate!
"In that case..."
Chen Guzhou decided to get the leading position as soon as possible, and then devoted all the resources of the Diaolong line to fight with all his strength.
Simulation Year 15.
A lot happened this year.
First, there was Zhou Rongguang's first wife Liu Fei. Due to her husband's neglect after his frustration, Hongxing had an affair.
Scandal comes to light.
Zhou Rongguang's face was so disgraced that he no longer had the face to see anyone.
Everyone's attitude towards this was - glad, glad that Chen Guyzhou didn't choose Liu Fei.
